headline_marked: [[Messi nets record double]] in Inter Miami's 4-2 win, becomes Leagues Cup all-time top scorer
headline: Messi nets record double in Inter Miami's 4-2 win, becomes Leagues Cup all-time top scorer
summary: Lionel Messi scored twice and assisted another, leading Inter Miami to a 4-2 victory over Atlético de San Luis. His two goals made him the Leagues Cup all-time leading scorer with 14 goals.
details: Lionel Messi became the all-time leading scorer in the Leagues Cup, netting twice in Inter Miami's 4-2 victory over Atlético de San Luis. This win took place today (Bangladesh time) in the 2026 edition's opening group matches.
The Argentine superstar equalized the visitors' early opener in the 11th minute, converting Noah Allen's pass. Telasco Segovia then put Miami ahead.
Messi scored again just before half-time, once more from an Allen assist, bringing his Leagues Cup tally to 14 goals. This achievement makes him the competition's historical top scorer.

He also provided the corner that led to Micael scoring Miami's fourth goal before the break. The 39-year-old was making his second appearance for Miami, and his first start, since helping Argentina finish runners-up at the 2026 World Cup.

Inter Miami's next Leagues Cup fixture is against Monterrey on Saturday. The Leagues Cup is an annual tournament featuring all 18 clubs from Mexico's Liga MX and 18 qualified clubs from Major League Soccer (MLS) in the US and Canada.

headline_marked: [[Gusty winds up to 60 km/h and thunderstorms]] forecast for 6 districts by afternoon
headline: Gusty winds up to 60 km/h and thunderstorms forecast for 6 districts by afternoon
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department has issued a warning for strong winds and rain in six coastal districts. River ports in these areas have been advised to hoist cautionary signal number 1 until 1 PM.
details: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has forecast gusty winds ranging from 45 to 60 kilometers per hour, accompanied by rain or thundershowers, in six districts by 1 PM today.
This warning, issued for internal river ports, specifically covers the regions of Khulna, Barishal, Patuakhali, Noakhali, Chattogram, and Cox's Bazar.
These areas are expected to experience temporary rain or thundershowers originating from the south/south-east direction, indicating a localized weather system.
Consequently, all river ports within these six regions have been instructed to hoist cautionary signal number 1, effective from 5 AM until 1 PM.
caption:
